## LLM020 Waiting on async work inside a transaction

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Level | warning |
| Framework | Both |
| Autofix | no patch; fix it by hand as described below |
| More | https://github.com/pgy763/llm-lint/blob/main/docs/rules.md#llm020 |
| Turn it off | `LLM020: off` in .llm-lint.yml, or `--disable LLM020` on the command line |

A transaction's boundary is the method, not the async snippet inside it. A block or a sleep keeps the database connection checked out from the start of the method to its end — it does not matter whether you wait for a model or for another thread, the pool is held either way. Move the wait outside the transaction, or let the transaction cover only the rows you actually write.

To mute it in one place, put `// llm-lint:ignore LLM020` on that line or the line above.
<!-- /generated:llm020 -->

## What it looks like

`.block()`, `Future.get()` or `Thread.sleep(...)` inside a `@Transactional` method.

## How to fix

Move the wait outside the transaction, or make the method asynchronous and keep the transaction to the write only.
